title: Null and booleans
notes: Null and the booleans are written as `null`, `true` and `false` (or another form every reader resolves the same way) and read back with the same types. This is a writing convention of the family, not the specification: a string is written plain only when every common reader reads it as that same string, so the text is judged under the YAML 1.2 Core schema (loose) and also under YAML 1.1 and the number forms common readers accept (strict).
